name: Coach Z
source:
Coach Z is the Ultimate Trainer who was responsible for training toons to fight against Sellbot HQ. He is a hotheaded, serious duck who is always getting into confrontations with those who go against his ideals. However, he has a softer side and ultimately just wants to protect the toons of Toontown. His personality is based off of the Toontown Youtuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/coachzucchini]CoachZucchini[/url]. 

[spoiler]If [url=/c143297]Cleff[/url] attacks [url=/c143286]Clara[/url] earlier in the day, Coach Z witnesses the attack and finishes Cleff off himself to prevent Clara from being executed as a killer. He sacrifices himself due to the hope that his sacrifice will prevent other murders. His execution is a reference to the CoachZucchini video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nYUqGiBNhmE]Preventing Cog Damage[/url].
